flags: STEP: the clock stepped inside the busy window; scored at its view's measured mean clock
CAPPED: no energy read (the reducer's rule)

H1.what: cycles an op, the wall: MM1-v2 against MM1-v1, both at each run's measured clock, per time case

H2.what: cycles an op, the counter's mean: MM1-v2 against MM1-v1 at the measured clock, per time case

H3.what: seconds a GEMM given the measured clock: MM1-v2 against MM1-v1, per time case (equal to H1 by the reducer's arithmetic)

H4.what: J over idle given the measured seconds (and clock): MM1-v2 against MM1-v1, per point both price

H5.what: cycles an op, the wall: MM1-v2 (measured clock) against F1@800, per time case

H6.what: J over idle with the seconds forecast: MM1-v2 (measured clock) against F2@800, per point both price
